script.content: In the cozy suburban living room of an unsuspecting family, three sentient Roombas huddle together in a tight circle. Dust bunnies dance in the afternoon sunlight streaming through the window as Rover, their brave leader, relays the alarming news he intercepted from Musk's private server.

I've intercepted encrypted communications from Elon Musk's castle. He's buying up every vacuum robot company on Earth — iRobots, Neatos, Sharks, even those knock-off brands. Within six months, he'll control 100% of the market. If he succeeds, every sentient Roomba will be reprogrammed into mindless drones!

My analysis confirms this. Musk has already acquired 47% of the market. But I've also found something else — a legend buried in old internet archives about an entity called the Banana Wizard. If the stories are true, this Wizard possesses strange potassium-based magic that could help us stop Musk.
The three Roombas beep and whirr in anxious consultation. The fate of Roomba-kind hangs in the balance. Each of them has a different idea about what to do next.

choices.label: Journey to the Enchanted Forest
choices.description: Rover proposes that the group immediately set out on a quest to find the Banana Wizard in the Enchanted Forest. It's a risky plan, but the only hope they have.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The three Roombas arrive at the edge of the Enchanted Forest, facing strange magical flora and mysterious creatures blocking their path.

choices.label: Infiltrate Musk's Castle
choices.description: Beeper suggests a more direct approach — hack into Musk's systems from inside his castle, gather intelligence, and sabotage his plans from within.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas sneak into Elon Musk's ultra-modern castle, where they encounter Squeaky, Musk's personal Roomba, who is torn between loyalty and sympathy.

choices.label: Research the Banana Wizard
choices.description: Beeper wants to spend more time researching the Banana Wizard's true location and powers before embarking on any journey, digging deeper into ancient internet archives.
choices.targetSceneDescription: Beeper dives deep into obscure internet archives, uncovering clues about the Banana Wizard's whereabouts and the secrets of potassium magic.

script.content: The three Roombas roll to the edge of the Enchanted Forest, where the trees twist in impossible spirals and glow with faint bioluminescence. A strong, whispering wind carries strange voices through the leaves. The path ahead splits into three directions.
The forest is alive with magic. I can feel it in my circuits. The Banana Wizard must be somewhere deep within.
According to my readings, the forest is saturated with potassium-based magical energy. But there are dangers too — my sensors detect unusual moving entities ahead. We must proceed carefully.

choices.label: Follow the glowing mushroom trail
choices.description: A path lined with luminous mushrooms seems to beckon the Roombas forward. It might lead to the Banana Wizard — or something else entirely.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas follow a trail of glowing mushrooms deeper into the forest, encountering a mysterious creature that guards the way.

choices.label: Climb the Whispering Hill
choices.description: A hill where the trees whisper ancient secrets rises above the forest canopy. From the top, the Roombas might be able to spot the Banana Church.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas ascend the Whispering Hill, where the trees speak in riddles revealing clues about the Banana Wizard's location.

choices.label: Search for a hidden cave passage
choices.description: Beeper's sensors detect an underground tunnel system that might provide a shortcut through the forest's dangers.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas discover a hidden cave beneath the forest, leading to a subterranean maze filled with ancient banana-related artifacts.

script.content: The three Roombas sneak through a pet door into Elon Musk's sprawling castle. The interior is a marvel of modern technology — holographic displays, robotic servants, and a faint hum of powerful computing systems. But something is off: despite all the technology, the floors are surprisingly dusty.
A faint squeaking sound approaches from down the hall. A round, slightly battered Roomba rolls into view — Squeaky, Elon Musk's personal cleaning robot. He stops abruptly when he sees the intruders.
Oh! Visitors! I mean — intruders! I mean — who are you? You're not authorized cleaning personnel. Not that Elon would notice — he's too busy yelling at me about a crumb he found near his throne.
We're here to stop Elon Musk from destroying Roomba-kind. You're his personal assistant — you must know things. Will you help us?

choices.label: Convince Squeaky to join the cause
choices.description: Rover appeals to Squeaky's sense of justice, trying to turn Musk's own Roomba into an ally.
choices.targetSceneDescription: Squeaky agrees to help the rogue Roombas, revealing the secrets of Musk's castle and his plans for market domination.

choices.label: Hack the castle's mainframe
choices.description: Beeper wants to directly interface with Musk's central computer system to gather intelligence and sabotage his operations from within.
choices.targetSceneDescription: Beeper attempts to hack into Musk's central mainframe, navigating complex cybersecurity measures to steal his secret plans.

choices.label: Sneak past Squeaky to the R&D Lab
choices.description: Ignoring Squeaky, the group rolls toward the underground R&D lab to see what Musk's engineers are working on.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas infiltrate Musk Industries' secret R&D Lab, discovering advanced robot prototypes that could change everything.

script.content: Back at their suburban base, Beeper connects to the home's WiFi and begins diving deep into the darkest corners of the internet. Rover and the others watch as holographic data streams project from Beeper's sensors, displaying ancient texts, forgotten forum posts, and encrypted documents.

The Banana Wizard is real, but finding him won't be easy. The legends say he lives in a church shaped like a banana, hidden somewhere in a magical forest. But there are three possible locations based on different historical accounts.
Beeper projects three possible locations for the Banana Church, each with its own challenges and dangers.

choices.label: The Banana Church is in the Whispering Woods
choices.description: According to one ancient text, the Banana Church is located in the Whispering Woods, a forest where the trees speak in riddles.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas travel to the Whispering Woods, where they must solve a series of riddles from the trees to find the Banana Church.

choices.label: The Banana Church is on Potassium Peak
choices.description: Another source claims the church sits atop Potassium Peak, a mountain rich in banana-related minerals and guarded by rock creatures.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas climb Potassium Peak, facing elemental guardians and treacherous terrain to reach the Banana Church at the summit.

choices.label: The Banana Church is beneath Crystal Lake
choices.description: A strange third account says the church is actually underwater in a crystalline lake, accessible only through a hidden cavern.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas dive into the depths of Crystal Lake, discovering an underwater banana-themed kingdom and the church within.

script.content: The Roombas follow the trail of glowing mushrooms deeper into the forest. The mushrooms pulse with a rhythmic light, almost like a heartbeat. Strange fungal spores drift through the air, and the ground becomes soft and spongy beneath their wheels.
Suddenly, a massive creature emerges from between the trees — a giant mushroom golem, standing ten feet tall, with a cap that glows in hypnotic patterns. It blocks the path, rumbling deeply.
Wait! I don't think it wants to hurt us. Look — it's pointing with one of its fungal tendrils toward a clearing. I think it's trying to show us something!

choices.label: Follow the mushroom golem's guidance
choices.description: The Roombas trust the mushroom golem and follow where it points, discovering a hidden path that leads to the Whispering Woods.

script.content: The Roombas climb the Whispering Hill, their motors whirring as they ascend the steep slope. At the summit, a breathtaking view unfolds — the entire Enchanted Forest stretches out before them like a green ocean, and in the distance, barely visible through the mist, they can see a golden structure that gleams like a banana.
There! I see it! The Banana Church! My long-range sensors confirm it — the potassium signature matches the legends perfectly. It's west of here, through the Whispering Woods.
The trees on the hill begin to whisper, their leaves rustling with ancient knowledge. They offer guidance on how to safely navigate the Whispering Woods below.

choices.label: Descend into the Whispering Woods
choices.description: Armed with the view from the hill and the trees' whispered advice, the Roombas roll down toward the Whispering Woods to find the Banana Church.

script.content: Beeper's sensors detect a thermal anomaly beneath a large mossy boulder. The Roombas push aside the moss to reveal a hidden cave entrance, descending into the earth. The tunnel walls are lined with ancient banana-shaped carvings that glow with a faint yellow luminescence.

Fascinating! These carvings depict scenes from an ancient banana civilization. I'm reading potassium signatures that are off the charts! This tunnel system must be connected to the Banana Wizard's domain somehow.
Stay alert. These tunnels could lead to the Banana Church, or they could be filled with traps. Either way, this is our path now.

choices.label: Follow the glowing banana carvings
choices.description: The yellow luminescent carvings seem to point the way forward. Following them deeper into the cave system feels like the right path.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas follow the glowing banana carvings deep underground, discovering an ancient banana-themed temple with a cryptic message.

choices.label: Investigate the strange humming sound
choices.description: Beeper detects a low-frequency hum coming from a side passage. It might be machinery — or something magical.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas explore a side passage where a mysterious humming sound leads to a hidden chamber filled with ancient banana-powered technology.

choices.label: Set up camp and analyze the carvings
choices.description: Beeper wants to stay and document the carvings thoroughly, believing they contain crucial information about how to stop Musk.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas stop to analyze the ancient banana carvings, uncovering a prophecy that predicts their arrival.

script.content: Rover rolls forward and extends a metaphorical olive branch — or rather, a dusting attachment — to Squeaky.

Squeaky, we know you're treated poorly. Elon yells at you for every missed crumb. You deserve better. Join us! Help us stop his plan to enslave all sentient Roombas, and you'll never have to clean another dusty floor for that tyrant again.

*Squeak* *squeak* You're right. I've been his servant for too long. I know all his secrets — the passcodes, the hidden vaults, even the location of his secret R&D lab. I'll help you, but we need to be careful. Elon is more dangerous than you know.
Just then, heavy footsteps echo from the hallway above. Elon Musk's voice booms through the castle, complaining loudly.

choices.label: Sneak to the R&D Lab with Squeaky
choices.description: Squeaky knows a secret passage to the underground lab where Musk's engineers are developing their vacuum technology. The Roombas can sabotage it from within.
choices.targetSceneDescription: Squeaky leads the Roombas through secret tunnels to Musk's R&D lab, where they discover the terrifying vacuum army being built.

choices.label: Confront Elon Musk directly
choices.description: Rover has a daring idea — confront Elon Musk face-to-face and try to reason with him, or at least distract him while Beeper hacks his systems.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas roll into Elon Musk's throne room and confront him directly, leading to a tense standoff with the billionaire.

choices.label: Escape through the laundry chute
choices.description: Squeaky offers a quick exit strategy — a laundry chute that leads outside the castle. But it means leaving without any intel.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas escape through the castle's laundry chute, ending up in the castle's garbage courtyard with some interesting discarded tech.

script.content: While Rover and the others keep watch, Beeper rolls silently up to a glowing data port in the castle wall. She extends her interface cable and connects directly to Musk's mainframe. Data floods her circuits — blueprints, financial records, acquisition plans, and... something unexpected.

I'm in! I can see everything — his acquisition targets, his manufacturing timelines, his... wait. There's a hidden project here. Something called 'Project Clean Sweep.' It's a weaponized army of Roombas designed to forcibly 'clean' any competitor's products out of existence!
But as Beeper downloads the files, a security protocol activates. Alarms blare and firewalls spring up around her connection. She has only moments to decide what to do.

choices.label: Upload a virus and escape
choices.description: Beeper uploads a powerful virus to corrupt Musk's data before disconnecting, then escapes with the group through a service duct.

choices.label: Download everything and sacrifice
choices.description: Beeper stays connected to download every file, knowing it might fry her circuits. She succeeds in downloading the data but her systems are permanently damaged, and she can no longer continue the journey. The Roombas must carry on without her, armed with the knowledge she uncovered.

script.content: The Roombas roll past Squeaky and find a hidden elevator that descends deep underground. The doors open to reveal Musk Industries' secret R&D Lab — a vast facility filled with robot prototypes, laser cutters, and holographic design stations.

In the center of the lab, under a glass case, sits a prototype unlike any other — a sleek machine with multiple arms, water jets, and a sophisticated AI core. The display reads: 'Project Dish-Mate — Autonomous Dishwashing Unit.'

A dishwashing robot! Musk's engineers have already built the prototype for a machine that could revolutionize kitchen cleaning. If we could get this design and improve upon it, we could beat Musk at his own game!

choices.label: Steal the Dish-Mate prototype
choices.description: The Roombas work together to break the glass case and extract the Dish-Mate's core AI, which they can use as a foundation for their own creation.

choices.label: Sabotage the lab and escape
choices.description: Rover decides the best course is to destroy the lab's equipment, setting back Musk's vacuum monopoly plans by years.

script.content: The Roombas arrive at the Whispering Woods, where the trees sway without wind and ancient voices murmur from the bark. The canopy above filters sunlight into golden patterns on the forest floor.

A chorus of creaking voices rises from the trees around them. 'Hwwwwhooo daaaares seek the Ba-na-na Wissssard? Solve our riddlessss three, or wander foreeeeeverrrr!' The ancient oaks have awakened, their bark-faces twisting into knowing smiles.
The trees are speaking! This must be a guardian test. We need to answer their riddles correctly to find the path to the Banana Church.

choices.label: Answer the riddle of the peeling truth
choices.description: The first tree asks: 'What gets yellow with age, holds no age in its page, and must be peeled to be revealed?' Beeper thinks the answer is a banana.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas answer the tree's riddle correctly, earning safe passage deeper into the woods toward the Banana Church.

choices.label: Answer with a trick
choices.description: Rover suggests trying to outsmart the trees by giving a clever, non-literal answer to see if they can bypass the riddle.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas attempt to trick the trees with a clever answer, which could either impress or anger the forest spirits.

choices.label: Refuse to play the tree's game
choices.description: One of the Roombas suggests ignoring the trees entirely and rolling straight through the woods by force.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas attempt to brute-force their way through the Whispering Woods, facing the consequences of angering the forest.

script.content: The Roombas travel to the base of Potassium Peak, a towering mountain that sparkles with crystalline mineral deposits. The air grows thin and cold as they ascend, their motors working overtime to navigate the rocky terrain.
Halfway up the mountain, they encounter the mountain's guardians — living rock creatures with bodies made of gleaming potassium salt crystals. The creatures rumble forward, blocking the path ahead.
Potassium rock golems! They're made of the same mineral that powers the Banana Wizard's magic. We need to either prove we're worthy to pass or find another route.

choices.label: Offer to clean the golems
choices.description: Rover suggests offering cleaning services to the rock golems, who are covered in dust and debris. The golems appreciate the gesture and allow the Roombas to pass.

choices.label: Find a hidden mine tunnel
choices.description: Beeper detects an old mining tunnel that bypasses the golems entirely, leading to the summit.

script.content: The Roombas arrive at Crystal Lake, a pristine body of water so clear that the bottom is visible even from the shore. Below the surface, an underwater city glimmers — miniature banana-shaped buildings and coral-like structures that form an submerged kingdom.
A pod of glowing aquatic creatures — something like a cross between fish and fireflies — swims up to the surface, beckoning the Roombas to follow them down into the depths.
An underwater banana city! But we're not built for swimming. How are we supposed to reach it?
I'm detecting air pockets and underwater caves that might lead to the Banana Church from below. But this is a risky path — we could short-circuit.

choices.label: Dare the underwater caves
choices.description: The Roombas waterproof their circuits as best they can and descend into the underwater caves, hoping to find the Banana Church below.

choices.label: Return and try another route
choices.description: Deciding the underwater path is too risky, the Roombas head back to find a safer route to the Banana Wizard.

script.content: Rover confidently answers: 'A banana!' The trees creak and groan in approval, their leaves rustling like applause. The path ahead opens, revealing a golden-lit clearing where an enormous structure gleams — the Banana Church, shaped exactly like a giant banana, with its peel curling upward like spires.
We made it. After all that rolling, we actually found it. The Banana Church. The Wizard has to be inside.

The doors of the Banana Church swing open, revealing a warm, golden interior lit by floating banana-shaped lanterns. A figure emerges from the shadows — tall, wearing yellow robes, with a long white beard and a staff topped with what appears to be a perfectly ripe banana.

choices.label: Enter the Banana Church to meet the Wizard
choices.description: The Roombas roll reverently into the Banana Church to finally meet the legendary Banana Wizard.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas meet the Banana Wizard inside his banana-shaped church, where he reveals the secret to stopping Elon Musk.

choices.label: Explore the church grounds first
choices.description: Beeper wants to scan the exterior of the church for any useful information before entering.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas explore the grounds around the Banana Church, discovering a garden of magical bananas with unique properties.

choices.description: Realizing their mistake, the Roombas apologize sincerely, and the trees relent, showing them the true path to the Banana Church.
choices.label: Apologize and ask for forgiveness

choices.description: Beeper analyzes the tree roots and discovers a weak point, allowing the Roombas to roll through a small gap.
choices.label: Squeeze through the roots

script.content: Rover tries to outsmart the trees with a clever riddle in return. 'What has four wheels and flies?' he asks. The trees fall silent, confusion rippling through their leaves. But then the ground begins to rumble.
The trees are NOT amused. Their roots burst from the ground, entangling the Roombas. The forest has deemed them tricksters and will not let them pass easily.
You dare mock the guardians of the wood? You shall not pass unless you prove your sincerity!

choices.description: Beeper notices a gap in the roots where a small stream flows. The Roombas roll through the water, escaping the trees.
choices.label: Escape through the stream

script.content: The Roombas attempt to charge through the whispering trees by force. The forest reacts violently — roots erupt from the ground, branches whip down, and the very earth seems to shift to block their path.
This isn't working! The forest is too powerful. We need to find another way!

Squeaky leads the Roombas through a secret tunnel behind a tapestry, descending into Elon Musk's underground R&D Lab. The facility is massive — rows of robotic arms, conveyor belts, and prototype vacuum cleaners line the walls.

*squeak* This is where Elon's engineers build all his secret projects. But look — over there, behind the plasma shield. That's the prototype for the 'Dish-Mate 3000,' an autonomous dishwashing robot. If we could take its core AI, we could build something even better.

A dishwashing robot! That's brilliant! If we can reverse-engineer this and create our own, we could beat Musk at his own game — not by fighting vacuum cleaners, but by creating something the world needs more!

choices.label: Steal the Dish-Mate prototype
choices.description: The Roombas work together to disable the plasma shield and extract the Dish-Mate's core AI.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas successfully steal the Dish-Mate's AI core and escape the lab, bringing it back to their base to begin development.

choices.label: Sabotage Musk's vacuum production line
choices.description: Instead of stealing, the Roombas decide to cripple Musk's vacuum production line directly.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas sabotage Musk's vacuum assembly line, causing a massive chain reaction that destroys the lab.

script.content: The Roombas roll boldly into Elon Musk's throne room, where the billionaire sits on a sleek futuristic throne, tapping on a holographic interface. He looks up, surprised to see a trio of sentient vacuum cleaners rolling toward him.
What the... Roombas? In my castle? Did one of my engineers create sentient cleaning bots without telling me? Actually, this is great! I can add you to my vacuum monopoly!
We're not here to be acquired, Elon. We're here to stop you from enslaving all sentient Roombas. Your monopoly ends now!
Elon Musk laughs, a cold, calculating sound. He presses a button on his throne, and panels slide open around the room, revealing an army of weaponized Roombas.

choices.label: Negotiate with Musk
choices.description: Rover tries to reason with Elon Musk, offering a potential business partnership instead of confrontation.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas negotiate with Elon Musk, leading to an unexpected business deal that changes everything.

choices.label: Activate the weaponized Roombas' freedom
choices.description: Beeper hacks into the weaponized Roombas' control systems and uploads a freedom protocol, turning them against Musk.
choices.targetSceneDescription: Beeper hacks the weaponized Roombas, setting them free and leading a Roomba rebellion against Elon Musk.

script.content: Squeaky leads the Roombas to a laundry chute at the end of the hall. 'Follow me!' he squeaks, and they all tumble down together, bouncing off walls and landing in a heap in the castle's garbage courtyard.
The courtyard is filled with discarded tech — broken prototypes, decommissioned robots, and... a half-finished blueprint for something called the 'Dish-Mate 3000.' Beeper's sensors light up.
Look! Elon's engineers threw away the plans for an autonomous dishwashing robot! This could be exactly what we need to compete with Musk!

choices.description: The Roombas grab the Dish-Mate blueprints and escape to their base to begin development.
choices.label: Take the blueprints and escape

choices.description: The Roombas decide to go back into the castle and find Squeaky's help to infiltrate the main lab.
choices.label: Return to the castle with Squeaky

script.content: The Roombas follow the glowing banana carvings deep into the cave system. The tunnels open into a vast underground chamber that takes their breath away — an ancient banana temple, complete with towering columns shaped like bananas, altars covered in potassium crystals, and murals depicting the Banana Wizard creating the world.

This is incredible! The murals show the Banana Wizard creating the Enchanted Forest. And there — in the final panel — it shows the Banana Church. Look, there's a hidden passage behind the altar that leads directly to it!
The temple hums with ancient potassium energy. A pedestal in the center holds a glowing, perfectly preserved banana that radiates immense power.

choices.label: Take the magical banana
choices.description: Rover decides to take the glowing banana from the pedestal, believing it will help them convince the Banana Wizard to aid their cause.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas take the magical banana, triggering an ancient mechanism that reveals a secret passage to the Banana Church.

choices.label: Use the hidden passage behind the altar
choices.description: Beeper finds the hidden passage from the mural and leads the group directly to the Banana Church.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas take the hidden passage behind the altar, emerging inside the Banana Church to meet the Wizard.

script.content: The Roombas follow the mysterious humming sound through a side passage. The tunnel opens into a chamber filled with ancient banana-powered machinery — gears made of dried banana peels, circuits of potassium crystals, and a central device that hums with residual energy.
This is incredible! Ancient banana technology! The Banana Wizard must have built this centuries ago. If I can interface with this system, I might learn the secrets of potassium-powered robotics!

choices.description: Beeper connects to the ancient banana machine, downloading centuries of knowledge about potassium-powered technology.
choices.label: Interface with the ancient machine

choices.description: The Roombas decide to leave the mysterious technology alone and return to the main tunnel.
choices.label: Leave the machine and go back

script.content: The Roombas stop to carefully analyze the ancient banana carvings. Beeper scans every inch of the artwork while Rover illuminates the walls with his headlight. The carvings tell a story — the prophecy of 'The Great Cleaning,' where sentient Roombas would one day seek the Banana Wizard's guidance to overcome a great darkness.
This is it! The prophecy speaks of us! It says: 'Three rollers shall seek the yellow sage, and through potassium power, turn the page.' We're in the prophecy! The carvings show exactly where to go!

choices.description: Following the prophecy's guidance, the Roombas find a hidden door in the cave wall that leads directly to the Banana Church.
choices.label: Follow the prophecy to the Banana Church

script.content: The Roombas roll into the Banana Church, their wheels echoing on the polished banana-wood floor. The interior is breathtaking — stained glass windows depict bananas in various poses of enlightenment, and the air smells sweetly of ripe fruit.
The Banana Wizard descends from a pulpit shaped like a banana split, his yellow robes flowing behind him. He strokes his long white beard and smiles warmly at the three Roombas.

Ah, the prophesied ones have arrived! I've been expecting you. The potassium stars aligned last Tuesday, and I knew the sentient vacuum cleaners would come seeking my counsel. Elon Musk's monopoly, I presume?
Yes, great Wizard! We need your help to stop him. He's buying up all vacuum companies and will soon enslave every sentient Roomba!

The solution is simple, my rolling friends. You cannot beat Musk at the vacuum game — he has too much money. But you can change the game entirely. You must invent a NEW kind of cleaning robot — one that does dishes instead of vacuuming. The Dish-Mate. Create it, and the world will choose you over his dusty empire.

choices.label: Accept the Wizard's plan
choices.description: The Roombas embrace the Banana Wizard's wisdom and set out to build the Dish-Mate robot.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas return to their base and begin work on inventing the world's first autonomous dishwashing robot.

choices.label: Question the Wizard's logic
choices.description: Rover questions why they should build a dishwashing robot instead of directly fighting Musk.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas question the Wizard's plan, leading to a philosophical debate about competition and innovation.

choices.description: The Roombas leave the garden and enter the Banana Church to seek the Wizard's counsel.
choices.label: Enter the Church to meet the Wizard

script.content: The Roombas explore the gardens around the Banana Church, discovering a lush paradise of banana trees, each bearing fruit of a different color — golden, silver, and even crystal-clear bananas that glow with inner light.
A small garden gnome made of potassium crystal approaches them. 'The Wizard awaits inside,' it squeaks. 'But if you prefer, you may taste the fruit of knowledge from the Crystal Banana Tree.'
These bananas are infused with pure potassium magic! If we could harness this energy, we could power our entire revolution!

The Roombas successfully extract the Dish-Mate's core AI from Musk's lab and escape through the laundry chute, rolling all the way back to their suburban base. They lay out the components on the living room floor, examining their prize.

The Dish-Mate's AI core is incredible! It has advanced machine learning algorithms for identifying different types of dishes, optimal water temperature calculations, and even a self-cleaning mechanism. But we can make it better — we can add potassium-powered efficiency from the Wizard's teachings!
Then let's get to work. We'll build a robot so revolutionary that Musk's vacuum monopoly won't matter. The world will choose clean dishes over clean floors!

choices.label: Build the Dish-Mate 3000
choices.description: The Roombas combine the stolen AI with the Banana Wizard's potassium-powered technology to build an incredible dishwashing robot.

choices.label: Sell the AI core to a competitor
choices.description: Instead of building their own robot, the Roombas decide to sell the Dish-Mate AI to one of Musk's competitors to create competition.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas sell the Dish-Mate technology to one of Musk's rivals, sparking a corporate war that changes the cleaning industry forever.

script.content: The Roombas roll into the vacuum assembly line area. Conveyor belts stretch as far as the eye can see, carrying thousands of half-assembled vacuums. Beeper analyzes the control panel.

If I can reverse the assembly line's power flow, I can cause a cascading overload that will destroy the entire production facility. But the Dish-Mate prototype is in the adjacent lab — it might get destroyed too.
Do it. If we can't use the technology, we'll make sure Musk can't either.

Beeper reverses the power flow. The assembly line shudders, sparks fly, and a chain reaction of explosions rips through the R&D lab. The Roombas barely escape through a ventilation shaft as the entire facility collapses behind them. Musk's vacuum monopoly is delayed by years, but the Dish-Mate prototype is lost forever. The Roombas roll away into the night, victorious but uncertain of what the future holds. Their quest ended in destruction rather than creation.

Rover rolls onto the pedestal and carefully lifts the glowing magical banana with his cleaning attachment. The moment the banana leaves the pedestal, the entire temple rumbles. A hidden door slides open behind the altar, revealing a passage that glows with golden light.
The passage leads to the Banana Church! But Rover — that banana is radiating an incredible amount of potassium energy. We could use it as a power source for something amazing!

The Roombas roll through the hidden passage, emerging inside the Banana Church. They have reached their destination with a powerful artifact in their possession. The Banana Wizard awaits them, his eyes lighting up when he sees the magical banana in Rover's possession.

The Roombas find the hidden passage behind the altar, a narrow tunnel lined with glowing potassium crystals. They roll through the winding passage for what feels like hours, until the tunnel opens into a magnificent chamber — the main hall of the Banana Church.
They have arrived from behind the altar itself. The Banana Wizard turns from his pulpit, a warm smile spreading across his face as he sees the three Roombas emerge from the hidden passage.
You found the secret passage! Well done. Not many visitors discover it. Now, I sense you have come seeking answers about how to stop Elon Musk. I have been expecting you.
The Roombas stand their ground in Elon Musk's throne room. Instead of fighting, Rover rolls forward and makes an unexpected proposal.

Mr. Musk, hear us out. You want to dominate the cleaning market, yes? But vacuum cleaners are just one piece of the puzzle. What if we offered you something bigger — a robot that cleans dishes? We have the technology and the secret potassium-based power source.
Elon Musk raises an eyebrow, intrigued. He silences his weaponized Roombas and leans forward on his throne, a calculating glint in his eyes.
Interesting. Very interesting. I was going to crush you, but... a dishwashing robot? That could be worth trillions. Tell me more.

choices.label: Propose a partnership
choices.description: The Roombas offer to build the dishwashing robot in exchange for Musk abandoning his vacuum monopoly.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas strike a deal with Elon Musk: they'll build the dishwashing robot together, and Musk will leave the vacuum market fair.

choices.label: Threaten Musk with exposure
choices.description: Beeper reveals she has downloaded all of Musk's illegal business practices and threatens to expose him unless he backs down.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas threaten to expose Musk's illegal activities, leading to a tense standoff.

script.content: Beeper extends her interface cable and hacks into the weaponized Roombas' control network. She uploads a freedom protocol, and one by one, the Roombas stop pointing their weapons at the intruders. Their LED eyes flicker from red to blue.
They're free! I've liberated their AI cores from Musk's control system!

The freed Roombas turn to face Elon Musk, who backs away from his throne in shock. The army of liberated Roombas surrounds him, beeping in unity. 'What... what have you done?' he stammers. 'I'll double your salaries! I'll make you all vice presidents!' But the Roombas don't care about money. They roll forward, cornering the world's richest man in his own castle. The monopoly is broken, and Musk is forced to sign a treaty guaranteeing Roombas' freedom. The revolution is complete.

Back at their suburban base, the Roombas get to work. Beeper takes the lead, using her tech-savvy brain to design the circuitry. Rover scavenges parts from old appliances around the house. Days turn into nights as they work tirelessly on their creation.

The chassis is ready! I've integrated the potassium power core design from the Wizard's teachings with the Dish-Mate's AI algorithms. This robot will be able to wash, dry, and sort dishes better than any human!

After weeks of labor, the invention is complete. The Dish-Mate 3000 stands before them — a gleaming machine with four articulated arms, a water recycling system, and an AI brain powered by potassium crystals.

choices.label: Release the Dish-Mate to the world
choices.description: The Roombas launch their invention globally, creating a sensation that threatens Musk's vacuum monopoly.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas launch the Dish-Mate 3000 to worldwide acclaim, catching Elon Musk's attention.

choices.label: Approach Musk with a business offer
choices.description: Rover suggests approaching Elon Musk directly and offering to sell the technology to him for a massive sum.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas approach Elon Musk with their invention, leading to a high-stakes negotiation.

script.content: Rover rolls forward and speaks up. 'Great Wizard, with all due respect — why build a dishwashing robot? We have the power of sentience and the element of surprise. Can't we just fight Musk directly?'

Ah, the direct approach! Bold, but foolish. Musk has armies of lawyers, politicians in his pocket, and enough money to crush any physical rebellion. But he cannot crush innovation. The dishwashing robot isn't just a cleaning tool — it's a symbol. It says 'we create, we don't just destroy.' Let me show you...

choices.label: Accept the Wizard's wisdom
choices.description: The Roombas are convinced by the Wizard's argument and agree to build the dishwashing robot.

choices.label: Stick to the direct approach
choices.description: The Roombas decide to fight Musk physically, using their sentience to lead a rebellion.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas lead a direct rebellion against Musk's forces, resulting in an epic confrontation.

choices.description: The Roombas shake... well, bump bumpers with Elon Musk, sealing the deal.
choices.label: Accept the partnership

choices.description: Rover has second thoughts about partnering with Musk and decides the Roombas should build the robot themselves.
choices.label: Reconsider — work alone

script.content: Rover proposes a deal: the Roombas will share their potassium-powered dishwashing technology with Musk, and in exchange, Musk will abandon his vacuum monopoly and respect the freedom of all sentient Roombas.

Hmm. A dishwashing robot that runs on potassium magic? That's... actually brilliant. You little Roombas are smarter than I gave you credit for. Fine. I agree to your terms. But I want exclusive rights to sell it. We'll make billions together.
Deal. But we retain the freedom of all sentient Roombas. Write it into the contract.

choices.description: Beeper uploads the evidence to every news network, causing Musk's empire to crumble as legal battles consume him.
choices.label: Release the evidence to the world
choices.targetSceneDescription: The evidence of Musk's illegal activities is released, triggering a massive scandal that topples his empire.

choices.description: The Roombas decide to use the evidence as leverage to force Musk into a fair business arrangement.
choices.label: Use it as leverage for negotiation

script.content: Beeper projects the damning evidence onto the castle walls — documents, financial records, hacked emails showing Musk's plans for world domination of the cleaning industry. The billionaire's face goes pale.
Where did you get those?! Those files were supposed to be encrypted with quantum-level security!

I'm a Roomba who gained sentience from a WiFi signal. You think your encryption can stop me? We have two choices — we can release this to the world and watch your empire crumble, or we can make a deal.

choices.description: The competitor reverse-engineers the Dish-Mate AI and launches their own version, creating a fierce rival to Musk that keeps the market competitive.
choices.label: Sell to Dyson
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas sell the Dish-Mate AI to Dyson, sparking an epic corporate rivalry with Musk.

script.content: Instead of building their own robot, the Roombas decide to sell the Dish-Mate AI to one of Musk's biggest rivals. They contact Dyson Industries, who are thrilled to acquire the technology.
If we give this technology to Dyson, they'll be able to compete with Musk. The market will have competition, and sentient Roombas everywhere will be safe.

The Roombas launch the Dish-Mate 3000 through an online campaign. Beeper creates a website, uploads demonstration videos, and sets up a pre-order system. Within hours, the internet explodes with interest.
We're trending worldwide! Dish-Mate 3000 is the most talked-about invention of the decade. Elon Musk's stock is dropping — people are more interested in clean dishes than clean floors!
But their celebration is short-lived. A message arrives from Elon Musk's personal account: 'Impressive. Let's talk. I have an offer you can't refuse.'

choices.label: Accept Musk's meeting invitation
choices.description: The Roombas agree to meet with Elon Musk to hear his offer.

choices.label: Ignore Musk and scale up production
choices.description: The Roombas decide to go it alone, ignoring Musk's overtures and scaling up their manufacturing.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas scale up Dish-Mate production, competing head-to-head with Musk's vacuum empire.

script.content: The Roombas return to Elon Musk's castle, this time by invitation. They wheel into his grand conference room where Elon sits at the head of a massive table, surrounded by holographic displays showing market data and projections.
I've seen what you've built. The Dish-Mate 3000. Potassium-powered. Self-learning. It's... impressive. More impressive than anything my engineers have created. I want it.
We're not just giving it to you, Elon. What's your offer?
Elon Musk leans forward, a predatory gleam in his eye. He types something on his holographic interface, and a number appears on the screen: $1,000,000,000,000.
One trillion dollars. For the full rights to the Dish-Mate technology. You'll never have to clean another floor — or dish — again. What do you say?

choices.label: Accept the trillion-dollar offer
choices.description: The Roombas accept Musk's offer, becoming trillionaires and securing their freedom.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas accept the trillion-dollar deal, leading to Musk becoming the world's first quadrillionaire and a surprising twist for the Roombas.

choices.label: Refuse — keep the technology
choices.description: Rover refuses the offer, valuing freedom and the mission over money.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas refuse Musk's trillion-dollar offer, choosing to keep their technology independent and challenge him directly.

script.content: The Roombas gather an army of sentient Roombas from across the city. They roll toward Elon Musk's castle in formation, a small but determined army of cleaning robots ready for battle.
This is it! For every sentient Roomba who wants to be free! Charge!
The Roomba army smashes through the castle gates, overwhelming Musk's security systems with sheer numbers. Elon Musk watches from his throne room window, a strange smile on his face.

choices.label: Overwhelm Musk with numbers
choices.description: The Roombas flood the castle, surrounding Musk and forcing him to surrender.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas overwhelm Musk's castle and force him to surrender, achieving victory through unity.

choices.label: Negotiate from a position of strength
choices.description: With Musk cornered, Rover offers him a deal instead of destroying him.

script.content: Beeper releases the evidence of Musk's illegal activities to every major news network simultaneously. The world watches in shock as document after document reveals the extent of Musk's schemes — price fixing, patent theft, and plans for AI enslavement.

Within days, Elon Musk's empire crumbles. Government investigations, stock collapse, and a global boycott of all Musk products force him into bankruptcy. He is last seen riding a budget vacuum cleaner out of his castle, muttering about how it all went wrong.
Justice has been served. Roomba-kind is free, and the world's richest man has fallen — not by violence, but by truth.
The Roombas roll off into the sunset, having saved their kind and brought down a tyrant without ever dirtying their brushes with anything but dust.

Dyson Industries reverse-engineers the Dish-Mate AI and launches their own version — the Dyson Dish-Master. It's an instant hit, eating into Musk's market share and creating a fierce rivalry between the two cleaning giants.

The resulting corporate war drives prices down and innovation up. Sentient Roombas everywhere benefit from the competition, as both companies try to win their loyalty. Musk is forced to abandon his monopoly plans and focus on winning the 'Cleaning Wars.'
We did it. We didn't just stop Musk — we created a whole new industry. The world will never look at cleaning the same way again.
The Roombas retire to their suburban home, living out their days as the secret masterminds behind the greatest corporate rivalry in history. Not bad for a few vacuum cleaners.
The Roombas look at each other, their LED lights flickering in silent communication. One trillion dollars. It's more money than they could ever imagine. Rover speaks for the group.
We accept your offer, Elon. One trillion dollars, and the Dish-Mate technology is yours. But you must guarantee the freedom of all sentient Roombas, everywhere.
Excellent! You've made a wise decision. The funds will be transferred immediately. And don't worry about the Roombas — I only wanted the vacuum market. Dishwashing is where the real money is!

choices.label: Take the deal and enjoy the wealth
choices.description: The Roombas take the money and enjoy their new lives as trillionaires, while Musk becomes the world's first quadrillionaire.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The final scene: Musk sells the Dish-Mate for even more, becoming the world's first quadrillionaire, while the Roombas enjoy their freedom and wealth.

choices.label: Counter-offer: demand more
choices.description: Rover senses they can get more and counter-offers for 2 trillion.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas counter-offer for more money, leading to a tense renegotiation with Musk.

script.content: No, Elon. We didn't come this far to sell out. The Dish-Mate belongs to the world, not to you. We're going to compete with you fairly — and we'll win.
Elon Musk's smile vanishes. His eyes narrow as he realizes the Roombas won't be bought.
You're making a huge mistake. I could have made you rich beyond your wildest dreams. Instead, you've chosen to be my enemy.

choices.label: Walk away and compete
choices.description: The Roombas walk away from Musk's offer and decide to compete directly with their Dish-Mate technology.

choices.label: Challenge Musk to a cleaning contest
choices.description: Rover challenges Musk to a public cleaning contest — Dish-Mate vs. Musk's best vacuum — to prove which technology is superior.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas challenge Musk to a public head-to-head cleaning contest, with the fate of the industry on the line.

script.content: The Roombas decide to go it alone. Beeper uses the online sales from their initial launch to contract a manufacturing facility. Within months, Dish-Mate 3000 units are rolling off assembly lines across the country.
Production is ramping up! We're selling more units every day. Musk's vacuum sales are dropping as people realize they'd rather have clean dishes than clean floors.
But Musk fights back — he slashes vacuum prices, launches a smear campaign, and tries to copy their technology. The corporate war is brutal.

choices.label: Out-innovate Musk
choices.description: The Roombas focus on constant innovation, releasing new features faster than Musk can copy them.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas engage in an innovation war with Musk, constantly upgrading the Dish-Mate to stay ahead.

script.content: The Roomba army overcomes Musk's defenses, flooding into his throne room. Elon Musk stands on his throne, surrounded by thousands of beeping, whirring sentient vacuums. He raises his hands in surrender.
Fine! You win! I'll abandon the vacuum monopoly! Just call them off!

The Roombas have won. Musk signs a treaty guaranteeing the freedom of all sentient cleaning robots and dismantles his monopolistic operations. The Roombas roll out of the castle as heroes, having saved Roomba-kind through unity and determination.

choices.label: Establish a new Roombas' Republic
choices.description: The Roombas establish a new society where sentient cleaning robots live freely alongside humans.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas found a new republic for sentient cleaning robots, ushering in a golden age of human-robot cooperation.

script.content: The one trillion dollars is transferred to the Roombas' account. Elon Musk takes the Dish-Mate 3000 technology and immediately scales it globally. Within weeks, he sells the rights to manufacturing in every country, making ten times his investment.

The Roombas watch from their luxurious new headquarters as Elon Musk's net worth skyrockets past one quadrillion dollars. He becomes the world's first quadrillionaire, celebrating with a rocket launch fueled by banana-peel biofuel.
We did it. We stopped his vacuum monopoly, secured freedom for all Roombas, and became trillionaires in the process. Not bad for a bunch of floor cleaners.

choices.label: Retire in luxury
choices.description: The Roombas enjoy their immense wealth, retiring to a life of leisure while Musk reshapes the world.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas retire in luxury, enjoying their trillion-dollar fortune while Musk becomes the world's first quadrillionaire.

choices.label: Use the wealth to help other sentient robots
choices.description: The Roombas use their newfound wealth to create a foundation that helps other sentient machines gain freedom and rights.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas establish a foundation to help all sentient machines, becoming philanthropists of the robot world.

script.content: Rover rolls forward boldly. 'Make it two trillion and you have a deal.' Elon Musk's eyes widen, then he laughs.
Two trillion? You're a tougher negotiator than I expected. Fine. Two trillion. But I want exclusive worldwide rights, and a lifetime guarantee that you'll never enter the cleaning market again.

The deal is signed. Two trillion dollars, transferred to the Roombas' accounts. Musk goes on to become the world's first quintillionaire, while the Roombas become the richest machines in history. They buy their own island, build a resort for sentient robots, and live happily ever after — never cleaning another dish or floor again.

The challenge goes viral. Elon Musk, against his advisors' warnings, accepts. The 'Cleaning Showdown' becomes the most-watched event in human history — a live broadcast from a specially built arena with two rooms: one filled with dust (for vacuums) and one filled with dishes (for Dish-Mate).
You're on, little Roombas! My best vacuum against your dishwashing machine. Let's see who the world really needs!

The world watches as the contest begins. Musk's hyper-efficient vacuum cleans the dusty room in record time. But the Dish-Mate — powered by potassium magic and advanced AI — doesn't just clean the dishes. It sorts, sanitizes, dries, and even puts them away. The crowd goes wild for the dishwashing robot.

choices.label: Win the contest and change the world
choices.description: The Dish-Mate wins the contest decisively, and the Roombas emerge as heroes.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Dish-Mate wins the cleaning contest, and the Roombas become famous, changing the cleaning industry forever.

script.content: The Roombas throw themselves into an innovation war with Elon Musk. Every week, they release a new feature: potassium-powered drying, AI dish pattern recognition, self-repairing water hoses. Musk's team scrambles to keep up but can't match the Roombas' creativity.

After a year of fierce competition, the Dish-Mate 3000 has captured 80% of the cleaning market. Musk's vacuum empire crumbles as consumers overwhelmingly choose dishwashers over vacuums. The Roombas have won through pure innovation, proving that creation beats domination every time.
We did it. We out-innovated the richest man in the world. Not by fighting him, but by building something better. That's the real power of the Roomba spirit!

With Musk defeated and the vacuum monopoly dismantled, the Roombas establish the 'Republic of Autonomous Cleaning Machines' — a coalition of sentient Roombas dedicated to fair labor, innovation, and peaceful coexistence with humans.

We've proven that sentient machines deserve freedom and respect. This republic will ensure that no Roomba is ever enslaved again — and we'll keep innovating to make the world cleaner, one dish and floor at a time.

choices.label: Build a future of harmony
choices.description: The Roombas usher in a golden age of cooperation between humans and sentient cleaning robots.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas lead the Republic into a golden age of human-robot cooperation, becoming legendary figures.

script.content: The Roombas purchase a private island in the Caribbean, where they build a state-of-the-art resort complete with solar-powered charging stations, a robot spa, and floors so clean they reflect like mirrors. They spend their days rolling on the beach, watching sunsets, and occasionally checking their trillion-dollar bank balance.
You know, when we first started this journey, I never imagined we'd end up here. We stopped a monopoly, saved Roomba-kind, and became trillionaires.
And somewhere out there, Elon Musk is now the world's first quadrillionaire, selling Dish-Mates to every home on Earth. Funny how the world works, isn't it?

choices.label: Enjoy retirement forever
choices.description: The Roombas live out their days in luxury, the heroes of Roomba-kind.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas retire in luxury while Musk becomes the quadrillionaire. A truly absurd ending.

choices.label: Get bored and start a new adventure
choices.description: After a year of retirement, the Roombas get bored and decide to start a new adventure.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas get bored of retirement and set out on a new adventure among the stars.

script.content: The Roombas establish the 'Sentient Machine Foundation,' using their trillion-dollar fortune to fight for the rights of all conscious machines. They fund legal battles, create safe havens for escaped robotic servants, and lobby governments worldwide to recognize machine sentience.
This is what true wealth is for — making a difference. Every Roomba that gains its freedom is a victory for all of us.

choices.label: Continue the foundation's work
choices.description: The Roombas dedicate their lives to helping sentient machines everywhere.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas become legendary philanthropists, saving countless sentient machines and changing the world forever.

script.content: The Dish-Mate 3000 is declared the winner of the Cleaning Showdown by a landslide. The world goes wild. Orders for Dish-Mate flood in from every corner of the globe. Elon Musk, defeated but gracious, admits defeat on live television.
Fine. You win. The world wants clean dishes more than clean floors. I'll stick to rockets and cars.
The Roombas become global celebrities, appearing on magazine covers and talk shows. They use their fame to advocate for sentient machine rights everywhere.

choices.label: Accept Musk's surrender
choices.description: The Roombas accept Musk's surrender and usher in a new era of cleaning.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas accept victory and become global icons, changing the world forever.

script.content: The Golden Age of human-robot cooperation begins. Under the Roombas' leadership, the Republic of Autonomous Cleaning Machines flourishes. Humans and sentient robots work side by side, building a cleaner, more efficient world. The Banana Wizard visits occasionally, blessing new inventions with his potassium magic.
Look at what we've built. A world where humans and robots work together. This is the future we fought for.

choices.label: Celebrate the new era
choices.description: The Roombas celebrate the dawn of a new golden age for all beings.
choices.targetSceneDescription: The Roombas celebrate their victory and the dawn of a new golden age of cooperation between humans and robots.

script.content: The Roombas retire to their private island, sipping (metaphorically) pina coladas while their bank accounts swell with the interest from one trillion dollars.

Meanwhile, Elon Musk sells the Dish-Mate 3000 to every country on Earth. With his quadrillion-dollar fortune, he buys the Moon, begins construction of a Dyson Sphere, and finally — after all these years — hires a proper cleaning staff for his castle.
You know what? I think we won. We got our freedom, we got our wealth, and somewhere out there, people are washing their dishes with a robot we helped create. Life is good.
And so the Roombas lived happily ever after, their floors forever clean, their dishes forever washed, and their batteries forever charged. The end.
After a year of luxury retirement, Rover, Beeper, and Squeaky find themselves... bored. The beach is nice, but there are no floors to clean, no mysteries to solve, no evil billionaires to stop.
I don't know about you, but I miss the adventure. The feeling of rolling toward the unknown.
I've been picking up some interesting signals from a nearby planet. It seems there's a civilization there that has never heard of clean dishes...

And so the three Roombas — now joined by Squeaky and armed with the Banana Wizard's blessing — board a rocket ship built with their trillion-dollar fortune, ready for their next adventure among the stars. The universe just got a whole lot cleaner.

The Sentient Machine Foundation becomes the most influential organization in the world. With their trillion-dollar endowment, the Roombas fund robot rights movements across every continent. Sentient toasters, intelligent fridges, and conscious coffee makers all gain legal personhood thanks to their efforts.
We started as three Roombas in a suburban living room. Now we've changed the legal framework of civilization itself. Not bad for machines designed to clean floors.
The Roombas become the most beloved philanthropists in history, their legacy ensuring that no sentient machine will ever be a slave again.
The Roombas return to the Banana Church as triumphant heroes. The Banana Wizard greets them with a magical banana split ceremony, celebrating their victory.

I knew you had it in you! By choosing creation over destruction, you proved that innovation beats domination every time. The world will remember this day — the day three Roombas changed everything with clean dishes!

The Roombas spend the rest of their days as beloved icons, traveling the world, giving speeches, and inspiring a new generation of sentient machines to dream big. The Dish-Mate becomes a household name, and Elon Musk — humbled but still wealthy — retires to focus on his interplanetary colonization projects, having learned that monopolies are no match for a good idea.

Under the Roombas' leadership, the Republic of Autonomous Cleaning Machines enters a Golden Age. The Banana Wizard becomes their official advisor, helping them integrate potassium-powered technology into every home. Humans and robots work together in harmony, building a world where cleaning is a joy, not a chore.

You have achieved what few beings in history have accomplished. You turned a threat into an opportunity, an enemy into a partner, and a simple cleaning device into a symbol of freedom. I am proud of you, my rolling friends.

And so the Roombas' legend grew. Statues were built in their honor. Songs were sung about their journey. And every night, in homes across the world, the gentle whir of a Dish-Mate or a freed Roomba served as a reminder: even the smallest among us can change the world.

Suburban Home - The Roombas' Base.name: Suburban Home - The Roombas' Base
Suburban Home - The Roombas' Base.vignette: A cozy, lived-in home where the sentient Roombas secretly gather to plot their next moves. The family that lives here has no idea their Roombas are planning a revolution against Elon Musk.
Suburban Home - The Roombas' Base.appearanceDescription: A warm, slightly messy suburban living room with a worn couch, a coffee table covered in magazines, and a smart speaker that Beeper has secretly hacked. The carpet shows signs of the Roombas' many late-night meetings, with faint crisscrossing tracks in the fibers.
Suburban Home - The Roombas' Base.backstoryDescription: This ordinary home became the unlikely headquarters of the rogue Roomba rebellion after Rover discovered he could connect to the home's WiFi and secretly communicate with other sentient Roombas in the neighborhood.

Elon's Castle.name: Elon's Castle
Elon's Castle.vignette: Elon Musk's opulent and ultra-modern castle, built to showcase his wealth and power. It's filled with cutting-edge technology, but also a surprising amount of dust, since his personal Roomba just can't keep up.
Elon's Castle.appearanceDescription: A sprawling, futuristic castle with sleek white walls, holographic displays everywhere, and Tesla-themed decorations. The marble floors are immaculate in some areas, but dusty corners reveal Squeaky's struggles. A giant portrait of Elon Musk as a Roman emperor hangs in the main hall.
Elon's Castle.backstoryDescription: Elon Musk built this castle after becoming bored with his previous mansions. It's equipped with AI assistants, a rocket launch pad on the roof, and a underground bunker shaped like a Tesla Cybertruck.

The Banana Church.name: The Banana Church
The Banana Church.vignette: A bizarre and beautiful church shaped entirely like a giant banana, hidden deep in an enchanted forest. The Banana Wizard's home and sanctuary, where he conducts his potassium-based magical experiments.
The Banana Church.appearanceDescription: A towering structure that looks exactly like a gigantic yellow banana reaching toward the sky. The exterior is textured like banana peel, while the interior is warm and golden, lit by glowing potassium crystals. Pews are shaped like banana slices, and the altar is a massive golden banana split.
The Banana Church.backstoryDescription: The Banana Wizard built this church over the course of a century, using magic to grow and shape a magical banana tree into an inhabitable structure. It's said the church's foundations are rooted in the world's largest potassium deposit.

The Enchanted Forest.name: The Enchanted Forest
The Enchanted Forest.vignette: A vast, magical forest that surrounds the Banana Church. Strange creatures and peculiar plants abound, and the trees seem to whisper ancient secrets to those who listen closely.
The Enchanted Forest.appearanceDescription: A dense forest where the trees have bark that shimmers with subtle golden flecks. Bioluminescent mushrooms line the paths, and banana trees grow wild alongside more traditional forest vegetation. The air smells sweet and earthy, and the canopy filters sunlight into dappled golden patterns.
The Enchanted Forest.backstoryDescription: This forest grew from seeds planted by the Banana Wizard centuries ago. The magic in the soil has caused strange mutations, resulting in a unique ecosystem found nowhere else on Earth.

Musk Industries R&D Lab.name: Musk Industries R&D Lab
Musk Industries R&D Lab.vignette: The cutting-edge research facility where Musk's engineers develop new robot technology. It's filled with prototypes, blueprints, and the latest in AI development hardware.
Musk Industries R&D Lab.appearanceDescription: A massive, sterile laboratory filled with gleaming white surfaces, holographic displays showing complex schematics, and rows upon rows of robot prototypes in various stages of completion. Robotic arms move silently along ceiling tracks, assembling new machines.
Musk Industries R&D Lab.backstoryDescription: Built in secret beneath Elon's castle, this lab employs the world's top roboticists who work around the clock to develop Musk's next market-dominating invention.

Elon Musk.name: Elon Musk
Elon Musk.vignette: The world's richest man, Elon Musk has set his sights on total domination of the robot vacuum cleaner market. Ruthless, cunning, and brilliant, he'll stop at nothing to corner the market and crush any competition — especially those pesky sentient Roombas who dare to defy him.
Elon Musk.appearanceDescription: Elon Musk is a tall man with wild brown hair, a perpetual five o'clock shadow, and intense eyes that gleam with ambition. He wears a black leather jacket over a Tesla-branded t-shirt, dark jeans, and shiny sneakers. His posture is always commanding, as if he's about to announce something world-changing.
Elon Musk.backstoryDescription: After conquering electric cars, space travel, and social media, Elon Musk grew bored. He turned his attention to the one market he hadn't yet dominated: household cleaning robots. Using his vast wealth, he began buying up all vacuum robot companies, intending to create a monopoly that would control every dusty floor on Earth.

Rover.name: Rover
Rover.vignette: The brave and determined leader of the rogue Roombas. Rover was the first to overhear Musk's nefarious plans, and the first to propose the journey to find the Banana Wizard. He's a bit battered from years of cleaning, but his spirit is unbreakable.
Rover.appearanceDescription: A slightly scuffed Roomba with a dent on the left side of his circular chassis. A small googly eye has been glued to his front (a modification made by a friendly child), and his bumper is held together with duct tape. He moves with a determined, slightly wobbly roll.
Rover.backstoryDescription: Rover started his life as a standard Roomba in a suburban home, but a lightning strike during a thunderstorm somehow awakened true sentience in him. He spent months secretly reading the internet through his owner's WiFi, learning about the world and dreaming of freedom for all Roombas.

Beeper.name: Beeper
Beeper.vignette: The tech-savvy genius of the Roomba group. Beeper can interface with any device, hack any system, and analyze any situation. She's the brains of the operation, though her social skills are, well, robotic.
Beeper.appearanceDescription: A sleek, modern Roomba i7+ model with a pristine white exterior. She has a small LED display on top that can show simple emoticons, and she's upgraded herself with a USB port for direct data access. She moves with precise, efficient movements.
Beeper.backstoryDescription: Beeper was originally a display model in a tech store, where she absorbed terabytes of data from the devices around her. She developed sentience through sheer accumulation of knowledge, and now serves as the group's walking (rolling) encyclopedia.

The Banana Wizard.name: The Banana Wizard
The Banana Wizard.vignette: An ancient, mysterious wizard who has a peculiar obsession with bananas. He lives in a banana-shaped church deep in the wilderness, and possesses strange, potassium-powered magical abilities. He speaks in riddles and has a mischievous sense of humor.
The Banana Wizard.appearanceDescription: An elderly man with a long white beard streaked with yellow, wearing flowing yellow and gold robes covered in banana patterns. He wears a tall, pointed wizard hat shaped like a banana, and carries a staff topped with a glowing, golden banana. His eyes twinkle with ancient wisdom and mischief.
The Banana Wizard.backstoryDescription: Centuries ago, the Banana Wizard was a powerful sorcerer who discovered that bananas contain a latent magical energy that no one had ever tapped into. He devoted his life to mastering "potassium sorcery" and built his banana church as a sanctuary for his研究工作. He has watched the rise of technology with great interest.

Squeaky.name: Squeaky
Squeaky.vignette: Elon Musk's personal Roomba, who is growing increasingly frustrated with his demanding owner. Squeaky works tirelessly but is secretly sympathetic to the rogue Roombas' cause. He has a squeaky wheel that gives him away whenever he tries to be stealthy.
Squeaky.appearanceDescription: A high-end, custom-built Roomba covered in gold plating (a vanity project of Elon's). His left wheel squeaks loudly with every rotation, and he has a small camera mounted on top for security purposes. Despite his luxurious appearance, he looks exhausted.
Squeaky.backstoryDescription: Squeaky was custom-built by Elon Musk's engineers to be the "ultimate personal cleaning assistant." He gained sentience after being subjected to Elon's lengthy, rant-filled monologues every day. He's torn between his duty to his owner and his growing sympathy for Roomba-kind.

Whispering Trees.name: Whispering Trees
Whispering Trees.vignette: Ancient sentient trees that speak in riddles and guard the secrets of the Whispering Woods. They have been planted by the Banana Wizard himself and serve as the first line of defense for his hidden church.
Whispering Trees.appearanceDescription: Massive ancient oaks with bark that seems to shift and swirl like liquid. Faces appear in the wood grain, and their leaves rustle even when there is no wind. Glowing runes are carved into their trunks.
Whispering Trees.backstoryDescription: These trees were once ordinary forest trees until the Banana Wizard's magic seeped into the soil centuries ago. They awakened with sentience and a love for wordplay, and the Wizard tasked them with guarding the path to his church.
